entities.summary: Dyurtyuli is a town in the Republic of Bashkortostan, Russia, located on the left bank of the Belaya River 126 kilometers (78 mi) northwest of Ufa. Population: 31,274 (2010 census); 29,984 (2002 census); 25,264 (1989 Soviet census).
